_source: D'vine spa - Galaxy UPDATED MENU.pdf (Illustrator export, 18 pages; content on pages 8, 10, 12-18)
_notes: REFERENCE ONLY, this menu was applied to the live database on 2026-09-15 by other means; the live catalogue was verified against this file on 2026-09-16 (all printed prices/durations match). Category and item names here follow the live database. The two 'Massage Extra Time' add-ons are not in the live catalogue.
Prices are RWF as printed. Durations are as printed; where the menu prints none (all waxing, all nail care) a working default is set and marked assumed:true so staff can adjust in the dashboard.
Bridal Glow Luxe is printed as 4-5 hrs; 270 min (4.5 h) is used.
Massage add-ons come from the NB on the packages page: +15 min = 10,000 RWF, +30 min = 15,000 RWF.
